title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Method of Granting Fixed Dates, etc.)
(1) A fixed date shall be granted by indicating the date of grant, fixed-date number, and fixed-date granting agency on the housing lease contract or digitized document.
(2) The public official in charge shall store in the computerized information processing organization a document obtained by converting a housing lease contract bearing a fixed date into electronic image information, or the digitized document.
